chunks: Al-Ḥalabī narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
That he was asked about a man who forgot and ate and drank, then remembered. He said:
"His fast is not broken; rather, it is something Allah has provided for him, so let him complete his fast."

key_terms.رَزَقَهُ اللَّهُ: Allah provided it for him as sustenance
key_terms.صَوْمَهُ: his fast, which he should continue and complete
key_terms.فَأَكَلَ: then ate during the state of forgetfulness
key_terms.وَشَرِبَ: and drank during the state of forgetfulness

ai.seo_question: Does eating or drinking forgetfully break the fast in Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith states that if a fasting person eats or drinks forgetfully and then remembers, the fast remains valid. It establishes a legal ruling in fasting and shows divine leniency, describing the forgotten act as provision from Allah.
